annotations.text:
RA2 — starting point

Four of the seven surfaces in mvp-spec.md §13. Census and Codelists are in the rail but not drawn: both are plain tables and inherit this vocabulary.

Static mockups, one direction: IBM Plex Sans/Mono, 3px radii, dense tables, one blue accent plus a semantic set. Buildable in NiceGUI/Quasar.

States the spec requires everywhere:

· anonymisation marking wherever text is shown
· dev-sized runs marked "smoke test, not a result" (Results uses the same header slot as the green Evaluation-run chip)
· cells below n=20 as "insufficient data", never a number
· ties shown as ties

Deliberately absent, and worth checking:

· no hallucination rate — it is a review tag, not a metric
· no per-record encoding damage score
· no mismatch clustering or cross-model agreement
· no per-entity scoring (captured, not scored)

Goal 2 has its own tab, not drawn — see spec §11.2, the one place the MVP narrows a promised deliverable.
